messages:
sara: Quick heads-up: we're updating invoice cutoffs, trial credit lifetime, and introducing a short overage grace window. Customers will get notice next week. :loudspeaker:

matt: can you summarize the exact changes?

sara: sure TL;DR:
1) Monthly invoice cutoff moves to 04:00 UTC on the 3rd (was midnight UTC on the last day).
2) New trial credits valid for 60 days (was 180). Existing credits keep current expiry.
3) Overage grace window: for Hosted customers we will allow a 72-hour soft grace where usage over quota is recorded but not billed immediately; after 72 hours overage charges apply. This is to reduce spike billing incidents.

olivia: why are we shortening credit validity so much? that's a big change for devs.

sara: main reasons: reduce long-tail credits affecting forecasting, and align with promotional cadence. Finance and Growth agreed. We kept grandfathering for existing credits to avoid disrupting current users.

zoe: for the 72-hour grace, how do we surface that in the Console? we need clear UX so customers aren't surprised.

sara: Console will show an "Overage grace active" banner with time remaining, plus email alerts at 24/48 hours. CS templates will be provided.

billing-bot: Note: Rate limits (requests/sec) unchanged. Overage soft-threshold logic updated in billing engine: `grace_window_hours=72` for hosted plans. Docs update queued.

matt: impact on accounting / revenue recognition?

finance-bot: Revenue recognition unaffected; we will accrue for usage and bill after grace. Ops: please review AR aging implications.

olivia: communication plan? when do customers hear?

sara: customer email goes out 10 business days before effective date. Public docs + FAQ update same day. Internal CS playbook and a short training session for CS ops on the release day.

zoe: any changes to Dedicated contracts or Reserved capacity?

sara: No contract terms change for Dedicated. Reserved capacity customers on contracts remain on existing invoicing dates; this change applies primarily to standard hosted billing cycles.

matt: action items please?

sara: Action list:
- CS: finalize email templates (owner: olivia).
- Docs: update billing page + FAQ (owner: matt).
- Billing eng: implement grace window & cutoff shift in staging and run e2e (owner: zoe).
- Finance: confirm AR treatment and forecasting update (owner: finance-bot).

billing-bot: Created task `billing-grace-window-2026-10` assigned to zoe, matt, olivia. Reminder set for 7 days before rollout.

sara: Thanks team. I'll post the customer-facing copy after CS reviews. Ping me if you run into anything. :thumbsup:
